description: Returns a list of Manual Forecast Line Items on a given project

id.description: Unique identifier for this manual forecast line item. Use as the {id} path parameter to update or delete the record via /rest/v1.0/projects/{project_id}/manual_forecast_line_items/{id}.

budget_line_item_id.description: ID of the budget line item this manual forecast line item forecasts against.

wbs_code_id.description: ID of the WBS (work breakdown structure) code associated with the parent budget line item.

budget_forecast_id.description: ID of the parent budget forecast that groups this line item.

project_id.description: ID of the project this manual forecast line item belongs to. Matches the {project_id} path parameter.

company_id.description: ID of the company that owns this manual forecast line item.

description.description: Free-text label for the forecast line item, typically the resource or role being forecast.

quantity.description: Number of units being forecast, expressed in the given unit of measure (uom).

uom.description: Unit of measure for the forecast quantity (for example, months or weeks).

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit, as a decimal string. Multiplied by quantity to produce amount.

amount.description: Total forecast amount (quantity multiplied by unit_cost), as a decimal string.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this manual forecast line item was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this manual forecast line item was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

currency_iso_code.description: Currency ISO Code configured for the financial entity
